name: Try You
summary: Shopify app that adds an AI virtual try-on button to product pages: shoppers upload a photo and see themselves wearing the item, with no monthly fee and usage billed per successful try-on through Shopify.
best_for: Shopify stores selling clothing, eyewear, bags, shoes or accessories that want shoppers to see the item on themselves, and prefer paying per use over a fixed monthly app fee
skip_if: your theme is not Online Store 2.0, your margins cannot carry a per-try-on charge on heavy traffic, or you cannot have shopper photos processed by third-party AI models outside the EU
honest_knock: The cost scales with use, not with sales: every successful try-on is billed, from $0.04 to $0.58 depending on quality, so a busy button on cheap products can cost more than it earns, and the volume-discount thresholds are not published. Shopper selfies go to Google or OpenAI, and as a fallback to ByteDance/BytePlus in Singapore, which matters if your shoppers are in the EU. The app asks for edit access to customers and 60 days of order history. It is young: listed since 13 May 2026, by Swicelso OÜ in Estonia.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Light · per usage, per successful try-on, no monthly fee
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-24 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/tryyou, the vendor site tryyou.fly.dev, its terms and its privacy policy) Free to install with 10 free try-ons, then pay per successful try-on with no monthly subscription. The price depends on the quality level you pick: Light $0.04 (1024 × 1536), Medium $0.12, Pro $0.19 (1024 × 1536), HD $0.37 and Ultra $0.58 (1536 × 2048, 2K). The vendor's own example: 100 try-ons cost about $4 on Light and $19 on Pro. Volume discounts go up to 50% off, down to $0.02 per try-on, but the thresholds are not published. You set a monthly spending cap between $5 and $10,000; failed try-ons are never billed; all charges go on your Shopify invoice in USD, and the terms say prices exclude tax. Uninstalling stops billing.

schema_offer.description: Light, per successful try-on, no monthly fee; Light $0.04, Medium $0.12, Pro $0.19, HD $0.37, Ultra $0.58; first 10 free; volume discount up to 50%, down to $0.02; monthly spending cap $5-$10,000; failed try-ons not billed; billed in USD through Shopify, prices exclude tax. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-24.

compare_with.name: A size guide and model photos
compare_with.why: The alternative most stores already have is a good size guide plus photos of the item on models of different builds, which costs nothing per view. Try You adds a picture of the shopper themselves, at $0.04 to $0.58 per try-on (read 24 October 2026). Its own analytics attribute orders to try-ons, so after a few weeks you can see whether that beats what the photos alone were doing.
